component.name: 3DCraft
component.summary: Parametric 3D CAD modeller built for AI

description.p: 3DCraft is a native, parametric 3D CAD modeller with its own kernel, sketch constraint solver and tessellator. Every action is a command, so the same engine is driven from the window, the command line, a JSON control channel or an MCP server.

The first release for people outside the project: parametric modelling driven by an AI agent over MCP, booleans, fillets and chamfers, sketches with a constraint solver, STEP import and export, STL, 3MF, OBJ, DXF and SVG export, and a user guide.
